label: golfphys coefficients. status: calibrated = fitted to cited published rows (see golfphys_validation.json for fit vs held-out); assumption = my choice; published = value quoted from a source (fetched/snippet in 'source').

e0.note: fit to 30 TrackMan 2010 carry-optimizer rows (smash/launch/spin); effective value absorbs head mass/COR (exceeds 0.83 legal COR because m_head is nominal)

s_t.note: tangential-impulse efficiency vs full rolling contact (uniform sphere M*vt/3.5); fit to the same rows
s_t.source: fetched chart; mechanism Cochran & Stobbs / Tutelman (snippet)

s_t_slope.note: fitted slope ~ -0.002/deg, not significant on held-out rows; fixed at 0

gear_h_rpm_per_mph_in.note: 16.4 rpm per mph ball speed per inch of horizontal offset

gear_v_rpm_per_mph_in.note: 25 rpm per mph per inch vertical offset

gear_mode.note: 'tutelman' empirical add-on; not validated against launch-monitor off-centre data (none collected)

bulge_radius.note: 10 in standard driver bulge (common spec, not verified in this session)

roll_radius.note: 12 in standard roll (common spec, not verified)

aero_model.note: Cl form 0.54 S^0.4 (curve-fit to Bearman & Harvey 1976 Fig. 9 as quoted; snippet) with scale calibration

cd_scale.note: fit: TM carry-opt carry + 3 landing-angle anchors; scales no-spin and spin Cd

cd_plateau.note: no-spin Cd after drag crisis (B&H qualitative)

cd_re_slope.note: slow Cd rise with Re after crisis (B&H qualitative)

cd_spin_slope.note: dCd/dS (induced-drag term) fit jointly; a 2-parameter fit could not match carry and 38 deg descent together

cl_cap.note: Cl saturation cap (never binds at driver S<0.15 after scaling)

spin_decay.note: 3.3-4 %/s spin loss (Tutelman spin-decay page); 0.04 used. Constant-rate; Smits&Smith have velocity dependence

normal.source: data/references/roll_aoa_validation.json (TrackMan/Foresight rows), USGA 'Golf Course Effects on Hitting Distance' (fetched)

soft.status: calibrated ONLY on one relative statistic: Broadie/ShotLink soft -5.31 / firm +4.49 yd of total vs medium (fetched USGA PDF); changes a_roll only
soft.source: data/references/roll_aoa_validation.json (TrackMan/Foresight rows), USGA 'Golf Course Effects on Hitting Distance' (fetched)

firm.status: calibrated ONLY on one relative statistic: Broadie/ShotLink soft -5.31 / firm +4.49 yd of total vs medium (fetched USGA PDF); changes a_roll only
firm.source: data/references/roll_aoa_validation.json (TrackMan/Foresight rows), USGA 'Golf Course Effects on Hitting Distance' (fetched)
